fields.label: Zip Codes in Territory
fields.name: zip_codes_in_territory
fields.instructions:
Add the comma-separated zip codes for this store's territory here without a space between each code. If a zip code is split between multiple stores, then use the polygon tool to draw the store's territory. Here is an example:
35004,35005,35006,35007,35008,35009,35010,35011
